rv.q: All this to say: tonally, “Jacob Marley’s Christmas Carol” was a pleasant surprise to me, and it’s a clever twist on a well-trod story.
Here’s hoping that Jacob Marley’s Christmas Carol at Lifeline Theatre is the beginning of another.

Whether you view the seasonal resurgence of Dickens’ story as overdone or a treasured tradition, Jacob Marley’s Christmas Carol breathes new, enchanting life into the classic and it is not to be missed.

cn.t: This inventive twist on Dickens gives Jacob Marley his redemption story with clever supernatural elements and rich language that mostly charms critics, earning strong praise for its fresh perspective on the classic tale.
